# TheSportzine FPL

> TheSportzine FPL is a fantasy football dashboard for viewing a Fantasy Premier League manager's squad, points, rank, fixtures, leagues and player price movement.

## Main application

- [FPL Dashboard](https://fpl.thesportzine.com/): Open the dashboard and enter an FPL manager ID to view public Fantasy Premier League data.

## Data and privacy

- The dashboard retrieves publicly available Fantasy Premier League data for the manager ID entered by the visitor.
- The manager ID is saved locally in the visitor's browser to make returning to the dashboard easier.
- The site does not provide an official Fantasy Premier League account login or manage transfers on a user's behalf.

## Publisher

- [TheSportzine](https://thesportzine.com/): Independent sports coverage and analysis.
